visual_synopsis: This is a COMPILATION / full episode of several unrelated sketches, separated by an animated apartment-block advert card and a white studio bumper. Segments include a fortune teller in a curly blonde wig and fur robes (male actor in drag) reading candles for a young woman in a dark red-curtained room, men arguing at an unfinished cinderblock building site, a mustachioed man driving and shouting into a mobile phone on a country road, a shoving scuffle between young men in an unfinished concrete building, and a group of village men drinking at a table in a bare orchard.
